figures.title: A Corrected Map of Britain according to Ptolemy (front-matter fold-out, faded landscape capture)
A Corrected Map of Britain according to Ptolemy's, or Rectified (front-matter fold-out, full spread)

Innerpeffery camp. (top plan) and Ardoch camp. (bottom plan): the two legionary camps of the Mons Graupius campaign per the book's text pp.43-44 ("the legions might poflibly have been at Ardoch, or Innerpeffery, before they marched to the battle"); each with its scale (200 / 300 yards), rivers Ruchel and Knoch, a military way and a Praetorium box

The five fecondary ftations per lineam valli: five fort plans, I GLANNIBANTA near Lanchester, II ALIONE now Whitley caftle, III BREMETEN RACUM now Old Penrith, IV OLENACUM now Old Carlisle, V VIROSIDUM near Elenborough; Praetorium boxes on I and III, Watling Street, a compass, "A feale of 100 paces"
A general map of the Roman walls in the north of England, and so much of the adjacent countryes as includes the secondary stations per lineam valli.
